Abre en tu navegador la página donde est: Opens in your browser the page with the ZIP of each version. The game stays open.
La versión del juego que tienes ahora. T: The version of the game you have now. After updating, the new one must show here.
Mira en la fuente elegida si hay una ver: Checks the chosen source for a newer version. If there is one, it offers to read what's new and install it; if not, it tells you that you have the latest. You need a connection.
Te lee lo que trae la versión nueva ante: Reads you what the new version brings before you decide whether to install it.
Un paso para actualizar a mano. Con flec: One step to update by hand. Down arrow takes you to the next one.
Pasan del banco a lo que llevas encima,: It moves from the bank to the cash you carry, with no fee. If you have less in the bank, you take out what there is.
Se lo lleva ahora y, a los {dias} días,: He takes it now and, after {dias} days, pays into your bank what is left after his {comision} percent. Now and then he vanishes with the money.
Usas ese efectivo, pierdes un {entero} p: You use that cash, lose {entero} percent and two hours go by. If you carry less, have less unexplained money or reach the daily limit, only what is possible gets laundered.
Al principio de la charla sube la confia: At the start of the chat it raises trust, more or less depending on their character. Repeating it gives little.
Borra la carpeta data, ia local, con el: Deletes the folder data, local AI, with the program and the model. You can download it again whenever you like.
No se borra nada y vuelves al menú del m: Nothing is deleted and you go back to the local model menu.
Pagas tú la habitación, aunque tengas ca: You pay for the room, even if you have a home. They may say no, depending on trust and what they are looking for.
Quién es y cuánta confianza te tiene. Co: Who they are and how much they trust you. With more trust they agree to more: being friends, doing you a favor or joining your gang.
Qué servicio y qué modelo contestaron la: Which service and which model answered last time in this session, and how long they took.
Si le hace gracia, sube la confianza y t: If they find it funny, trust and your mood go up; if not, trust drops a little. It depends on their character.
Sube la confianza, más o menos según su: It raises trust, more or less depending on their character, and lifts your mood a little. If you have been talking for a long while, it gives little.
Te cuenta qué datos salen de tu ordenado: Tells you what data leaves your computer when you talk to people using AI mode.
Te cuenta su oficio. Sube un poco la con: They tell you their job. It raises trust a little.
Te dice cuál es el más cercano, a cuánto: They tell you which is the nearest, how many meters away and in which direction, and mark it on your GPS. If there is none in this town, they tell you.
Te dice en qué barrio estás y cómo es. S: They tell you which neighborhood you are in and what it is like. It raises trust a little.
Te explica qué es un modelo local, qué d: Explains what a local model is, what the game downloads and how long it takes to answer.
Tus conocidos aparecen aquí: puedes llam: Your contacts show up here: you can call them and meet them for a drink.
Algo guardado en esta cocina, con lo que: Something stored in this kitchen, with how much is left and when it expires. Here you can only check it: to eat it or take it, go to the kitchen of the house.
Con Intro eliges qué hacer con ello: com: With Enter you choose what to do with it: eat it, if it is eaten as it is, carry one with you or throw it away.
Lo que compres para casa en una tienda d: What you buy for home at a food shop is stored in the kitchen, with Store what you are carrying.
Qué lleva cada receta, cuánto tarda y cu: What each recipe needs, how long it takes and how filling it is, and how many dishes you have cooked. Your level goes up with each dish.
Tiras todo lo que queda de esto, de una: You throw away all that is left of this, at once and without asking. It cannot be undone.
Una receta que sabes hacer, con lo que l: A recipe you know how to make, with what it needs. It is cooked in the kitchen of one of your houses, in Cook.
A qué se dedica esta empresa y si repart: What this company does and whether it pays dividends.
Abre el menú de tu perro: acariciarlo, d: Opens your dog's menu: pet it, feed it, send it to search or send it home.
Deshace todos tus cambios de botones y c: Undoes all your changes to buttons and combinations, on foot and driving, and goes back to the default layout. It does not ask first.
Dónde está tu perro, cuánta hambre tiene: Where your dog is, how hungry it is and how much it trusts you.
El botón y lo que hace ahora. Con Intro: The button and what it does now. With Enter you choose another action for it.
El mando vibra un momento para que compr: The controller vibrates for a moment so you can check you feel it. It must be connected.
Eliges qué hace cada botón cuando conduc: You choose what each button does while you drive. Changes are saved right away.
Eliges qué hace cada botón cuando vas an: You choose what each button does while you are on foot. Changes are saved right away.
Eliges un sitio de esta localidad y el t: You choose a place in this town and the taxi takes you. The price and the hours that go by depend on the distance. With the police after you or in the middle of a mission, it won't pick you up.
Eliges uno de los vehículos que guardas: You choose one of the vehicles you keep in your garages, in any town, and your mechanic leaves it in the street, next to you.
En casa tiene comida y agua, y se le pas: At home it has food and water, and its fear wears off. From here you call it back to you.
Es lo más que llega a tener tu salud: cu: It is the most health you can have: the more, the more hits and shots you can take. Each workout at the gym raises it five points, one a day.
Este botón pasa a hacer esto, y el cambi: This button will now do this, and the change is saved right away.
Hace falta una casa tuya con garaje, com: You need a house of yours with a garage, bought and not rented.
La lista de lo que hace cada botón a pie: The list of what each button does on foot, driving and in the menus, with your current layout.
La lista de todos los logros, cuáles tie: The list of all achievements, which ones you already have and what each one takes.
La secuencia más larga que has repetido: The longest sequence you have repeated without a mistake on the memory machine.
Las vendes al precio de hoy y te dice si: You sell them at today's price and it tells you whether you gain or lose compared to what they cost you. If you have fewer than ten, you sell the ones you have.
Llega uno armado con pistola, te sigue y: One arrives armed with a pistol, follows you and fights by your side. He also charges {precio} euros every midnight. You can have two at most.
Lo que te darían hoy por todas tus accio: What you would get today for all your shares, and what you gain or lose compared to what you paid for them.
Lo último que ha pasado en las empresas,: The latest that has happened at the companies, with the day of each piece of news.
Los barrios que son tuyos, sumando todas: The neighborhoods that are yours, adding up all the cities. Each one pays you every midnight and lets you keep more people in your gang.
Los sanitarios te curan donde estás y te: The paramedics treat you where you are and leave your health at maximum. They don't come if there are enemies nearby, and if you are not hurt they don't charge you.
Los tesoros que has sacado en toda la pa: The treasures you have found in the whole game, at all the search spots.
Mientras no esté a tu lado no puedes aca: While it is not by your side you can't pet it, feed it or send it to search.
Pagas cien veces el precio de hoy: unos: You pay a hundred times today's price: about {precio} euros.
Pagas diez veces el precio de hoy: unos: You pay ten times today's price: about {precio} euros.
Pagas {precio} euros y tu mecánico se ll: You pay {precio} euros and your mechanic takes the vehicle to this garage. If you were in it, you are left on foot. If the garage is full, it can't be done.
Para tener uno aquí, guárdalo antes en e: To have one here, first store it in the garage of a house of yours.
Pones una ficha de {apuesta} euros a un: You put a {apuesta} euro chip on a single number out of thirty-seven. If it comes up, you win {premio} euros plus your chip.
Pones una ficha de {apuesta} euros y gir: You put down a {apuesta} euro chip and the ball spins. If you win, you get your chip back and the same again. With zero you lose.
Pones una ficha de {apuesta} euros. Acie: You put down a {apuesta} euro chip. You win if one of those twelve numbers comes up, and you win twice the chip. With zero you lose.
Quita el marcador que guardaste el últim: Removes the marker you saved last. The others stay as they are.
Si hay un mando conectado y cuál es. Se: Whether a controller is connected and which one. It is detected by itself when you plug it in, without leaving the game.
Suenan diez dianas a la izquierda, al ce: Ten targets sound on the left, in the center or on the right, and you quickly press the arrow for that side. With seven hits you win {p7} euros; with nine, {p9}.
Tells you what this place is like.
Te despides de tu perro para siempre y s: You say goodbye to your dog for good and it stays here. The donation is not returned. Later you can adopt another.
Te explica de una vez cómo se mueven los: Explains in one go how prices move, how you make money and how dividends are paid.
Te lo comes en el sitio y te sube un poc: You eat it on the spot and it raises your health a little.
It pays you every midnight without you doing anything. If a gang attacks it, you have until midnight to defend it or you lose it.
Te sientas en la mesa y cada apuesta te: You sit at the table and each bet costs you {a} euros. What you win depends on what you bet on.
Tu mecánico lo saca del garaje y te lo d: Your mechanic takes it out of the garage and leaves it in the street, next to you. In the middle of the sea or with a lot of police after you, he doesn't come.
Tu nivel en cada habilidad, del uno al d: Your level in each skill, from one to ten, and your maximum health. They go up by themselves with practice, and F1 explains each one.
Un botón y lo que hace. Se cambia en Rea: A button and what it does. It is changed in Reassign, in the controller menu.
Un logro se consigue solo, en cuanto hac: An achievement is earned by itself, as soon as you do what it says, and the game announces it with a sound.
Una noticia de una empresa, del día que: A piece of news about a company, from the day it says. News moves its price.
Una parte de la explicación. Con flecha: One part of the explanation. Down arrow takes you to the next one.
Ve a una de esas ciudades y vuelve a abr: Go to one of those cities and open this menu again to see its neighborhoods.
Vendes todas las que tienes de esta empr: You sell all the shares you have in this company at today's price, and it tells you how much you gain or lose on the sale.
Vuelves al juego con el GPS puesto hacia: You go back to the game with the GPS set to that point. If it is in another town, you have to travel there first.
Vuelves al juego y llegan todos juntos a: You go back to the game and they all come for you together, in a single wave.
Te dice en qué carpeta se está guardando: Tells you which folder this session's log is being saved in and how many sessions are kept.
Te lee lo que se apunta en el registro y: Reads you what goes into the log and what never does, so you know what you are sending.
Te lee los pasos para comprimir la carpe: Reads you the steps to compress the folder of the session that failed and where to send it.
Empiezas la partida con este personaje y: You start the game with this character and their advantages.
Sube un poco tu prestigio entre los veci: It raises your standing with the neighbors and your mood a little. You can repeat it as often as you like.
Tu prestigio entre los vecinos sube diez: Your standing with the neighbors goes up ten times more than by donating fifty, and your mood improves too. You can repeat it.
Una línea del resumen de tu vida en la p: One line of the summary of your life in the game. Down arrow takes you to the next one.
